title: Adaptive Randomized Neural Networks with Locally Activation Function: Theory and Algorithm for Solving PDEs
summary: This paper establishes an approximation theory and develop an adaptive computational framework for randomized neural networks (RaNNs). For RaNNs of the form $\sum_{i=1}^{N} W_i σ(A_i\cdot x+B_i)$ with hidden parameters uniformly sampled from a bounded set of scale $M$, we show that the choice $M \asymp N^{p/[2((p-1)(d+1)+pη)]}$ yields an expected $W^{k,p}$-approximation error of order $\mathcal{O}\left(N^{-pη/[2((p-1)(d+1)+pη)]}\right)$, where $η$ is associated with the regularity of the target function in a generalized Barron spectral space.
